summary: Dynex Capital filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $120M offering of 4.8M shares of 9.375% Series D fixed-rate cumulative redeemable preferred stock at a $25.00 liquidation preference, with an expected issuance date of September 29, 2026. Dividends accrue at $2.34375 per share annually, payable quarterly from January 15, 2027. The Series D ranks senior to common and pari passu with the 6.900% Series C preferred. This is a routine preferred equity shelf takedown, not an event-driven special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal premium is disclosed.
